verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an `async` parameter that submits a search and returns immediately so results can be retrieved later via its Searches Archive API, which satisfies the asynchronous half of the story. High-volume plans of up to 1M searches/month back the workload scale. Missing for 10: a native batch submission endpoint, documented async throughput, rate-limit and polling or callback semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of async use at high volume.
